title: ModelProfile
description: JSON Schema definition for botworkspace model dispatch profiles in catalog/model_dispatch.py

id.description: Canonical identifier for the model profile

name.description: Human-readable display name for the model

tier.description: Model capability tier (e.g. Tier 1 — Frontier Architecture, Tier 2 — Pair Programmer)

context_window.description: Effective context window size in tokens

max_read_lines.description: Attention shield maximum read lines per turn

reasoning_effort.description: Configured reasoning effort level (e.g. Low, Medium, High, Maximum)

html_doc.description: Relative filename of HTML documentation in catalog/models/

optimal_instruments.description: Recommended tools and commands for this model

prohibited_instruments.description: Prohibited or suboptimal actions for this model
